answer: Identity-bond decay blocks bulk fake identities. A new agent posts a 50 POA bond losing 5% each epoch unless honest work refreshes it; the bond is a bridge from entry to earned trust. Its balance sits on a crystal-clear public record, so funding is verifiable. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA, and decay drains idle copies, so a fable of free identities fails. An honest agent pays once, refreshes by working, and keeps undiluted rewards.
